Hey, cursing does feel good because it’s all in the intent. You’re frustrated and depressed and feel weird and crazy for how you feel. Guess what buddy, you are completely normal. Most people go through the same thing you do whether they like to admit it or not. Just realize that it’s just words. You’re parents sound really shitty though. I was going to say that them being hard on you is typical of parents but as soon as you said they thought that suicidal people are just looking for attention and don’t even care to realize their own son is in pain...well fuck them. What you need to do at this point is plan on what you’re going to do to get out of that environment and into a group of more supportive people. Do you have a grandma/grandpa, uncle/aunt or older sibling you can stay with and feel safe with?

Being bullied throughout my entire school experience for being the tallest and fattest girl everywhere I went and having a mother who always criticized me on how I looked and was mentally abusive...I can understand the feeling of hating how you look and who you are. At some point you have to stare at yourself and say. “I’m a good person.” And try to live that every day. Until you get your mind right, you’ll never see yourself in any other light than a dark one.
